Surface Y RNAs at the gut–immune interface
papers.abstract: Cell-surface RNAs are emerging as active components of immune-cell communication. A study now identifies monocyte surface Y RNAs as amplifiers of histone-driven innate immunity, raising questions about their contribution to intestinal inflammation and their potential as biomarkers and therapeutic targets.

papers.summaryZh: 本研究聚焦於細胞表面 RNA 在免疫細胞溝通中的角色。研究指出單核細胞表面的 Y RNA 可作為組蛋白驅動先天免疫的放大因子。該發現與腸道-免疫介面相關，並引發其對腸道發炎貢獻的疑問。作者也提出此類表面 Y RNA 可能具有作為生物標記與治療標靶的潛力。

papers.title: Mechanosensitive YAP–RUNX1 signaling drives TH1 cell dysfunction and tumor immunosuppression
papers.abstract: Solid tumor stiffness can limit the ability of immune cells to enter and kill tumor cells. Here the authors show that this stiffness activates YAP signaling in type 1 helper T cells, making them dysfunctional and thereby leading to a more immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment.
papers.titleZh: 機械敏感 YAP–RUNX1 訊號驅動 TH1 細胞功能失調與腫瘤免疫抑制
papers.summaryZh: 本研究指出實體腫瘤的硬度可能限制免疫細胞進入並殺傷腫瘤細胞。作者顯示此硬度會在第1型輔助 T 細胞中活化 YAP 訊號，使其功能失調。TH1 細胞功能失調進而導致腫瘤微環境更具免疫抑制性。

papers.title: How marine particles shaped microbial evolution over Earth’s history
papers.abstract: We argue that shifts in the abundance and composition of marine particles impacted horizontal gene transfer, consequently shaping the evolutionary landscape of the oceans throughout Earth’s history. We focus on two pivotal transitions — the emergence of cyanobacteria and the rise of eukaryotic algae.
papers.titleZh: 海洋顆粒如何塑造微生物在地球歷史上的演化
papers.summaryZh: 該文提出海洋顆粒的豐度與組成變化影響了水平基因轉移，進而在地球歷史上塑造了海洋的演化格局。作者聚焦於兩個關鍵轉變：藍細菌的出現與真核藻類的興起。研究將海洋顆粒視為影響微生物演化的重要因素。該論點為理解海洋微生物演化提供了新的視角。

papers.title: Hunt for the origins of an influenza pandemic
papers.abstract: Martha Nelson revisits the emergence of the 2009 swine flu pandemic and considers what it can teach us about animal movements, viral evolution and prevention of future pandemics.
papers.titleZh: 追溯2009年豬流感大流行的起源
papers.summaryZh: 本文由 Martha Nelson 回顧2009年豬流感大流行的出現。文章探討該次大流行如何提供關於動物移動的線索。作者也討論病毒演化的相關議題。內容進一步思考這些觀察對預防未來大流行的啟示。

papers.title: Dual-use virology research in the age of AI
papers.abstract: We propose that dual-use research of concern policies should reflect emerging risks from recent technological innovations, including artificial intelligence, to ensure continued global biosafety, while acknowledging the wider societal benefits of genetic modification of viruses.
papers.titleZh: AI時代的雙用途病毒學研究
papers.summaryZh: 本文提出雙用途研究關注政策應反映近期技術創新帶來的風險，其中包括人工智慧，以確保全球生物安全。作者同時指出政策調整需要在風險管控與維持研究效益之間取得平衡。文中特別提到病毒基因改造所帶來的更廣泛社會效益應被承認。整體而言，文章主張政策應因應AI等新興技術而更新。

papers.title: A PTN-Rich MSC Subtype Promotes Cartilage Repair in End-Stage Knee Osteoarthritis
papers.abstract: Mesenchymal stem cell (MSC) therapy for end-stage knee osteoarthritis (KOA) shows inconsistent efficacy, and whether MSCs retain cartilage repair capacity in the inflammatory joint remains unclear. Using single-cell RNA sequencing of human Kellgren-Lawrence grade (G ) and (G ) KOA joint tissues and exogenous MSCs, we found that pleiotrophin (PTN) signalling shifts from MSC-chondrocyte crosstalk to chondrocyte-dominated autocrine signalling, with PTN exhaustion and elevated cluster of differentiation 74 (CD74) in G cartilage. We therefore identified and sorted a PTN-rich CD74-low placenta-derived MSC subtype and evaluated it in a murine KOA model and in co-culture with patient-derived chondrocytes. This subtype enhanced cartilage repair, upregulated SOX9, and suppressed MMP13, CD74, IL-6, and IL-1{beta}, potentially through CD74 suppression and reduced NF-{kappa}B signaling. These findings provide a basis for functionally defined, stage-matched cell therapy tailored to the pathological microenvironment of end-stage KOA.
papers.titleZh: 富含 PTN 的間充質幹細胞亞型促進末期膝關節退化軟骨修復
papers.summaryZh: 間充質幹細胞（MSC）治療末期膝關節退化性關節炎（KOA）療效不一致，且 MSC 在發炎關節中是否仍保有軟骨修復能力尚不明確。研究以單細胞 RNA 定序分析人類 Kellgren-Lawrence 分級（G ）與（G ）KOA 關節組織及外源性 MSC，發現 pleiotrophin（PTN）訊號從 MSC-軟骨細胞交互作用轉為軟骨細胞主導的自分泌訊號，並伴隨 PTN 耗竭與軟骨中 CD74 上升。研究團隊因此分選出 PTN 豐富且 CD74 低的胎盤來源 MSC 亞型，並在小鼠 KOA 模型及與患者來源軟骨細胞共培養中評估其作用。此亞型促進軟骨修復、上升 SOX9，並抑制 MMP13、CD74、IL-6 與 IL-1β，可能透過 CD74 抑制與 NF-κB 訊號下降。結果為針對末期 KOA 病理微環境的、功能定義且分期匹配的細胞治療提供基礎。

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Personalised Gene Expression Prediction Improves Cell-Type-Specific Association Testing
papers.abstract: Linking genetic variation to disease requires accurate prediction of its effects on gene expression in relevant cell types. Sequence-to-function models offer a way to predict these effects and, with training on personal genomes, have begun to capture inter-individual expression differences. However, effect sign accuracy remains limited, and predictive uncertainty is unquantified. Here we introduce ATTICUS, which combines personalised sequence representations with uncertainty-aware expression prediction. ATTICUS transfers regulatory information learned in bulk expression pretraining to cell-type-specific expression prediction without requiring genotypes paired with single-cell expression data. Across blood and brain cell types in OneK1K and ROSMAP, ATTICUS approximately doubles expression prediction correlations relative to scPrediXcan and substantially improves sign accuracy. Moreover, ATTICUS enables uncertainty-aware transcriptome-wide association studies (TWAS). Applied to systemic lupus erythematosus and Alzheimer's disease, ATTICUS identifies more associations, with greater cell-type specificity and stronger directional concordance, and reduced statistical inflation. Together, our results demonstrate that personalised training makes predictions more directionally consistent, and uncertainty propagation improves the calibration of TWAS and the prioritisation of disease genes. ATTICUS provides a framework for both, enabling the use of single-cell expression datasets without matched genotypes to inform uncertainty-aware TWAS, expanding their use in prioritising disease-associated genes and cell types.
papers.titleZh: 具不確定性感知的個人化基因表現預測提升細胞類型特異性關聯檢驗

papers.title: MorphoANOVA: Dissecting Histology-Gene Expression Relationships in Spatial Transcriptomics
papers.abstract: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) measures the expression of hundreds to thousands of genes within tissue architecture, often accompanied by histology images. However, it remains challenging to systematically characterize which genes exhibit associations with tissue morphology, whether these associations vary spatially, and which genes show additional spatial expression patterns beyond those captured by morphology. Here we introduce MorphoANOVA, a gene-wise statistical framework for characterizing morphology--expression relationships across genes measured by ST. Using nested spatially varying coefficient models and sequential ANOVA, MorphoANOVA assesses slide-wide associations with an H\&E-derived morphology feature, location-specific changes in these associations, and additional spatial variation after accounting for the selected feature. The resulting statistics enable gene prioritization and pathway enrichment analysis, while spatial component maps support the interpretation of individual genes. Simulations demonstrate MorphoANOVA's ability to distinguish the modeled components and recover their spatial patterns. Applications to human cortex and breast cancer identify biological programs associated with different morphology--expression patterns and reveal distinct relationships with cell composition. Across three HER2-positive breast cancer patients, invasive-cancer marker genes consistently exhibit stronger evidence of location-specific morphology associations. MorphoANOVA thus provides a framework for systematically interpreting spatial gene-expression patterns in relation to tissue morphology.
papers.titleZh: MorphoANOVA：解析空間轉錄組學中的組織學-基因表現關係

papers.title: scPolyA enables efficient, interactive and agent-guided alternative polyadenylation analysis in single-cell and spatial transcriptomes
papers.abstract: Alternative polyadenylation (APA) changes which regulatory sequences an RNA retains, creating a layer of cellular variation that gene-level expression profiles cannot resolve. Here we present scPolyA, a unified, AI-enabled framework that transforms conventional single-cell and spatial 3'-end transcriptomes into quantitative maps of RNA-end choice. scPolyA connects de novo poly(A)-site discovery to cell- and spot-resolved measurements of terminal-site usage, 3' untranslated region length and intronic polyadenylation, enabling differential APA analysis across cell states and tissue regions. Its integrated deep-learning module, DeepCPS, improves recognition of sparsely supported poly(A) sites and predicts cleavage positions at nucleotide resolution. An integrated graphical workspace brings parameter exploration, efficient rerunning and genome browsing together, while an APA-specialised AI agent translates natural-language research questions into executed analyses, verified outputs and evidence-guided interpretation. Across diverse single-cell protocols and spatial platforms, scPolyA achieves higher reference-atlas agreement than most evaluated de novo methods, while single-cell benchmarks demonstrate competitive runtime and memory use. Applied to cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma, scPolyA reveals recurrent 3' untranslated region shortening in tumour keratinocytes across all ten patients and corresponding patterns in tumour-enriched regions, with tissue-level contrasts shaped by cellular composition. scPolyA extends conventional transcriptomics from gene abundance to RNA-end regulation, linking transcript choices to cellular states and tissue organisation.
papers.titleZh: scPolyA 實現單細胞與空間轉錄組中高效、互動且代理引導的替代性多聚腺苷酸化分析

papers.title: Contrasting within-donor gene covariation identifies disease-associated cells and genes in case-control single-cell studies
papers.abstract: In case-control single-cell studies, disease often affects only a subset of cells of a given type within each patient. Comparing all cells from patients with all cells from control donors therefore dilutes disease signals, while donor variation and recorded or unrecorded batch effects can be confounded with disease status. We present IDC (Identification of Disease-associated Cells), which uses this cellular heterogeneity as signal. A mixture of affected and unaffected cells creates coordinated variation among disease-associated genes within each patient, whereas shifts shared by all cells of a donor leave this within-donor covariance unchanged. IDC therefore contrasts within-donor gene-gene covariance between patients and controls to learn disease-associated expression programs without batch labels, then applies positive-unlabeled learning to score each cell's disease-like state and estimate each donor's disease burden. IDC also computes, in closed form, gene contribution scores and leave-gene-out cell scores that exclude each tested gene, enabling within-donor differential expression testing and cross-donor meta-analysis without retraining. In simulations, IDC identified affected cells and estimated donor burden more accurately than deep generative and label-refinement methods, remained robust to strong unrecorded batch effects, and detected differentially expressed genes more sensitively than case-control pseudobulk methods while controlling false discoveries. In human pancreatic islets and prefrontal cortex, disease burden in held-out donors separated type 2 diabetes (T2D) from non-diabetic donors in beta cells, and late-stage Alzheimer's disease (AD) from non-AD donors in astrocytes and inhibitory neurons, while placing prediabetic and early-AD donors at intermediate levels. Genes with the highest IDC contribution scores were more strongly enriched for the KEGG T2D and AD pathways than case-control pseudobulk rankings, and within-donor testing revealed coordinated metabolic, cell-adhesion and synaptic changes along the inferred disease axis.
papers.titleZh: 對比供體內基因共變異於病例對照單細胞研究中鑑定疾病相關細胞與基因

papers.title: scHiR learns joint cellular representations from paired single-cell transcriptome and 3D genome data
papers.abstract: Simultaneously sequenced scRNA-seq and scHi-C technologies provide matched measurements of gene expression and three-dimensional (3D) genome organization within individual cells, offering complementary insights into cellular state. However, integrative analysis remains challenging due to the heterogeneous structures and characteristics of these modalities. To realize the full potential of such data, we need effective computational methods to learn joint cellular representations. Here, we present scHiR, a framework based on a hyperspherical variational autoencoder (S-VAE) for learning co-embeddings from paired gene-expression profiles and chromatin contact maps. The framework facilitate downstream analyses such as cell clustering, fine-grained cell-state characterization, and developmental trajectory inference, while modality-specific decoders enable the signal recovery of input profiles. We evaluated scHiR across six paired datasets generated by HiRES, GAGE-seq, and LiMCA. scHiR captured cell-type-specific information and achieved improved clustering performance compared with representative single-omics methods. It was also capable of resolving fine-grained subclusters and revealed discordant and distinct cellular profiles. In developmental biological datasets, scHiR preserved trajectory-related structure and improved pseudotime in agreement with known developmental progression. Finally, scHiR generated reconstructed transcriptomic and chromatin contact profiles with reduced noise, enhanced cell-type-related signals, and improved recovery of held-out chromatin contacts. These results demonstrate that scHiR provides an effective method for learning joint cellular representations from paired scRNA-seq and scHi-C data.
papers.titleZh: scHiR 從配對的單細胞轉錄組與三維基因組數據學習聯合細胞表徵

papers.title: THiRST: Computer Vision Empowered Three-dimensional High-Resolution Spatial Transcriptomics Analytics
papers.abstract: High-resolution spatial transcriptomics (ST) preserves gene expression within tissue architecture but remains limited to individual two-dimensional (2D) sections, restricting analysis of continuous three-dimensional (3D) structures and cross-section consistency. We present THiRST, a computational framework for reconstructing multi-resolution 3D spatial transcriptomic representations from serial sections. THiRST combines coarse-to-fine morphology-guided registration, spatial matching of ST units, cross-section association of segmented structures, and integration of Visium V2 and high-definition ST. In serial kidney sections, patch-level refinement increased the same-cluster proportions of matched units at adjacent offsets from 63.8% and 65.6% to 70.7% and 70.0%, respectively, while improving expression concordance. The reconstructed correspondences enabled 3D glomerular and object-level expression analysis, with 54.1% of differential genes detected only in 3D. Cross-platform integration further aligned V2 and high-definition measurements in a shared expression space. THiRST demonstrates the feasibility of object-level 3D ST analysis from serial 2D sections and underscores the importance of accurate local registration.
papers.titleZh: THiRST：以電腦視覺驅動的三維高解析度空間轉錄組學分析

papers.title: A single-cell transcriptomic atlas of the pigtail macaque lung
papers.abstract: Background: The lungs undergo substantial physiological and immunological changes during respiratory illness to meet the host's increased metabolic and oxygen demands. These responses require coordination among epithelial, endothelial, stromal, and immune cells throughout the respiratory zone, interstitium, and vasculature. Nonhuman primates (NHPs) are a valuable model for studying pulmonary biology as they have similar anatomic, physiologic, and immunologic correspondence to humans. Despite the widespread use of NHPs in pulmonary research, the cellular diversity and molecular characteristics of the pigtail macaque lung remain incompletely defined. Methods: Parenchymal lung tissue from five adult female pigtail macaques (Macaca nemestrina) was dissociated into single cells and profiled using 10x Genomics 3' single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-Seq). Next, ambient RNA was removed and quality control analyses performed. Samples were then integrated using scVI and scANVI. Cell types were labeled after unsupervised clustering and subclustering, followed by manual annotation using canonical marker genes. We compared lineages and cell types with the Level 4 Human Lung Cell Atlas (HLCA) using scArches reference mapping and with the Rhesus Immune Reference Atlas (RIRA) using Seurat label transfer. Results: The atlas includes 61,323 cells representing 37 cell types in epithelial, mesenchymal, endothelial, lymphoid, and myeloid populations. Annotated populations included both major and rare lung cell types, including alveolar type I and II cells, club and multiciliated cells, aerocyte capillary, and lymphatic endothelial cells, pre-terminal bronchiole secretory cells, CD4+ and CD8+ T cells, and several innate-like lymphocyte populations (gamma delta T cells, MAIT-like cells, innate-like CD8+ T cells, and group 3 innate lymphoid cells). There was strong concordance at HLCA annotation level 4, including AT1 and AT2 cells (96% and 93%), B cells (94 to 97%), CD4+ T cells (99 to 100%), classical and non-classical monocytes (84% and 85%), alveolar macrophages (80%), and mast cells (96%). Immune populations mapped to the RIRA with similar fidelity (alveolar macrophages and B cells, 99%). Conclusions: While studies of pandemic respiratory infections, vaccines, and therapeutics rely on NHP disease models, this atlas provides a unique reference for epithelial, endothelial, stromal, and immune cell states in the pigtail macaque lung. We found that single-cell populations from the pigtail macaque lung are highly similar to those in the human lung at the lineage level. This reference will enable studies of pathogenesis and vaccine and drug efficacy in a highly translational model of the human lung.
papers.titleZh: 獮猴肺單細胞轉錄體圖譜
papers.summaryZh: 本研究以五隻成年雌性獮猴的肺實質組織為材料，進行 10x Genomics 3' 單細胞 RNA 定序，並以 scVI 與 scANVI 整合樣本後進行分群與手動註解。研究建構的圖譜包含 61,323 個細胞，共 37 種細胞型別，涵蓋上皮、間質、內皮、淋巴與髓系族群。註解的族群包含肺泡 I 型與 II 型細胞、杯狀與多纖毛細胞、氣血屏障毛細血管與淋巴內皮細胞、近末端支氣管分泌細胞，以及 CD4+ 與 CD8+ T 細胞等多種先天樣淋巴細胞族群。與人類肺細胞圖譜 HLCA Level 4 的比對顯示強烈一致性，例如 AT1 與 AT2 細胞分別達 96% 與 93%，B 細胞 94 至 97%，CD4+ T 細胞 99 至 100%。

papers.title: Calibrating developmental dynamics from single-cell atlases: lineage paths outrun least-action routes
papers.abstract: Single-cell atlases infer developmental dynamics from destructive snapshots, yet how far realized lineage paths depart from such inferred dynamics has never been measured with controls. We introduce LADD (Least-Action Developmental Dynamics), a measurement framework that learns a stochastic developmental vector field from time-series single-cell RNA-seq and computes minimum-action and minimum-time paths, together with a three-layer calibration protocol that separates genuine path deviation from the generic cost of centroid measurement, and we compare its forecasting component with optimal-transport and flow-matching methods. In the lineage-resolved Caenorhabditis elegans atlas, the raw action ratio of observed lineage-centroid trajectories to optimal paths is 3.79, yet forward-simulated ensembles of the learned model itself score 2.07, leaving a genuine excess of about two-fold. In zebrafish (Danio rerio), the observed ratio sits entirely at the model's floor. Three mechanisms that could explain the residual deviation (detours, flow-opposition, and fate-map complexity) are each excluded; what remains is speed, with lineages moving 30-43% faster along the learned flow. We report validity boundaries for temporal resolution, cross-species comparison, and energetic interpretation, delimiting where action-based trajectory comparisons are meaningful.
papers.titleZh: 校準單細胞圖譜中的發育動態：譜系路徑超越最小作用路徑
papers.summaryZh: 研究團隊提出 LADD（Least-Action Developmental Dynamics）測量框架，從時序單細胞 RNA-seq 學習隨機發育向量場，並計算最小作用與最小時間路徑，同時以三層校準流程區分真正的路徑偏差與質心測量帶來的通用成本，並與最佳傳輸與流匹配方法比較預測能力。於譜系解析的線蟲 Caenorhabditis elegans 圖譜中，觀察到的譜系質心軌跡與最佳路徑的原始作用比為 3.79，而學習模型本身前向模擬的集合為 2.07，剩餘約兩倍的真實超額。於斑馬魚 Danio rerio 中，觀察到的比值完全落在模型基線範圍內。作者排除繞行、逆流與命運圖複雜度等三種可能機制後指出剩餘偏差主要來自速度，譜系沿學習流移動的速度比預期快 30-43%。研究亦報告時間解析度、跨物種比較與能量詮釋的有效邊界，界定作用基礎軌跡比較的適用範圍。

papers.title: Cancer-associated fibroblasts as architects of tumor immune geography and lymphoid organization
papers.abstract: Cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs) are a heterogeneous population of stromal cells that participate in the formation of tertiary lymphoid structures (TLSs). Here, the authors review the current knowledge on how CAF subsets shape the organization and function of immune cells within TLS and discuss the clinical implications of these CAF-TLS interactions.
papers.titleZh: 癌症相關纖維母細胞形塑腫瘤免疫地理與淋巴組織
papers.summaryZh: 本文為綜述，指出癌症相關纖維母細胞 Cancer-associated fibroblasts, CAFs 為異質性的基質細胞族群，並參與第三型淋巴結構 Tertiary lymphoid structures, TLS 的形成。作者回顧目前關於 CAF亞群如何影響 TLS 內免疫細胞組織與功能的認識。文中亦討論 CAF-TLS 交互作用的臨床意涵。

papers.title: The transcriptional regulator IκBζ is essential for ILC2 effector functions
papers.abstract: Group 2 innate lymphoid cells (ILC2) are important for the anti-helminth immune response. Here the authors show that the effector program of ILC2s depends on transcriptional regulation of the alarmins IL-25 and IL-33 by IκBζ, leading to efficient hookworm clearance in a mouse model.
papers.titleZh: 轉錄調節因子 IκBζ 對 ILC2 效應功能不可或缺
papers.summaryZh: 第二型先天性淋巴球細胞 ILC2 與抗蠕蟲免疫反應有關。本研究指出 ILC2 的效應程序依賴轉錄調節因子 IκBζ 對警報素 IL-25 與 IL-33 的轉錄調控。該調控與小鼠模型中鉤蟲清除效率相關。結果顯示 IκBζ 在 ILC2 效應功能中扮演必要角色。

paper.title: Evidence and measures of the digital usage divide from 40 million Windows devices
paper.abstract: Using usage data from 40 million Windows devices, this paper develops measures of digital engagement in the USA, revealing digital inequalities that are not captured by traditional measures of internet access alone.

paper.title: SimPoly: Simulation of polymers with machine learning force fields derived from first principles
paper.abstract: The authors develop a machine learning force field trained only on quantum-chemical data that can reproduce measured key polymer properties such as densities and glass transition temperatures.

paper.title: Archival and palaeoenvironmental documentation of extreme climate events reveals generational amnesia in collective memory
paper.abstract: Collective memory shapes how societies respond to climate extremes, but its long-term biases are hard to observe. Here, the authors show that historical severity assessments of droughts and floods in northern China over 430 years are biased toward recent experience, consistent with an agent-based model of generational amnesia.
